name: Exp_NRTR_ATR_STOP_Tm
summary: This EA implements the NRTR (Nick Rypock Trailing Reverse) indicator combined with ATR-based dynamic stop levels to trail trends and generate entry/exit signals. It includes a time management filter that restricts trading to user-defined sessions. The system opens positions when the NRTR line reverses direction, confirming a new trend, and uses ATR multiples for adaptive stop-loss placement.
summary_zh: 该EA实现了NRTR（Nick Rypock追踪反转）指标结合ATR动态止损水平来跟踪趋势并产生入场/出场信号。它包含时间管理过滤器，将交易限制在用户定义的时段内。当NRTR线反转方向确认新趋势时系统开仓，并使用ATR倍数进行自适应止损设置。
strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略基于NRTR（Nick Rypock Trailing Reverse）指标，这是一种动态追踪趋势的指标，通过不断调整支撑/阻力水平来识别趋势反转。入场条件为NRTR指标线发生方向反转——当价格突破上轨时做多，突破下轨时做空。ATR被用于计算动态止损距离，使止损幅度根据市场波动率自适应调整，高波动时止损更宽，低波动时止损更紧。仓位管理通过固定手数或基于资金的百分比计算来实现。时间管理模块允许用户设定交易活跃时段，避免在不利时段开仓。出场主要依赖NRTR信号反转和ATR止损触发，属于典型的趋势跟踪系统，适合中长周期运行。
strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy is based on the NRTR (Nick Rypock Trailing Reverse) indicator, a dynamic trend-trailing tool that continuously adjusts support/resistance levels to identify trend reversals. Entry conditions trigger when the NRTR line reverses direction — a long position is opened when price breaks above the upper channel, and a short position when it breaks below the lower channel. ATR is used to calculate dynamic stop-loss distances, making the stop width adaptively adjust to market volatility: wider stops in high-volatility environments and tighter stops in low-volatility conditions. Position sizing is implemented through either fixed lot sizes or percentage-based capital allocation. The time management module allows users to define active trading sessions, avoiding entries during unfavorable periods. Exits are primarily driven by NRTR signal reversals and ATR-based stop triggers, making this a classic trend-following system suitable for medium-to-long timeframe operation.

pros: ATR自适应止损机制能根据市场波动率动态调整，避免固定止损被频繁触发
时间管理过滤器有效避免在低流动性或高噪音时段开仓，提高信号质量
NRTR指标具有趋势追踪和反转识别的双重功能，能较好地捕捉中期趋势
系统逻辑清晰，参数含义直观，便于用户理解和优化
pros_en: ATR-adaptive stop-loss mechanism dynamically adjusts based on market volatility, avoiding frequent fixed stop triggers
Time management filter effectively prevents entries during low-liquidity or high-noise sessions, improving signal quality
NRTR indicator combines trend-trailing and reversal identification, capturing medium-term trends effectively
Clear system logic with intuitive parameter meanings, making it easy for users to understand and optimize
cons: 趋势跟踪系统在震荡市中容易产生频繁虚假信号导致连续亏损
缺乏明确的止盈机制（TakeProfit_ATR默认关闭），盈利可能大幅回吐
没有持仓数量检查，可能在同方向重复开仓导致过度集中风险
未包含点差过滤，在高点差环境下入场成本可能过高
cons_en: Trend-following systems are prone to frequent false signals and consecutive losses in ranging/choppy markets
Lacks explicit take-profit mechanism (TakeProfit_ATR defaults to off), profits may be significantly given back
No position count check, potentially opening repeated positions in the same direction leading to over-concentration risk
No spread filter included, entry costs may be excessive in high-spread environments
improvements: 增加震荡市过滤机制（如ADX或波动率通道），在低趋势强度时暂停交易以减少虚假信号
添加持仓数量限制和同方向重复开仓检查，防止单一方向过度集中
增加点差过滤和滑点保护，提高实盘执行的稳健性
improvements_en: Add a ranging-market filter (e.g., ADX or volatility channel) to pause trading during low trend strength and reduce false signals
Add position count limits and same-direction duplicate entry checks to prevent over-concentration in one direction
Add spread filter and slippage protection to improve robustness in live execution

risk_points: 缺少持仓数量检查可能导致同方向过度开仓
未设点差过滤器在高成本环境下可能亏损入场
趋势跟踪策略在震荡市中会产生连续亏损
risk_points_en: Missing position count check may lead to over-opening in the same direction
No spread filter may cause entries in high-cost environments leading to immediate losses
Trend-following strategy produces consecutive losses in ranging markets
